t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They advised me to keep note of which gnomes lead to which forest. In a gnome-pair, one of them will lead me to the dark forest, and the other will lead me to the bright forest. There are four gnome pairs of different colours. The number of mushrooms in each forest changes so I should keep track which gnomes lead to which forest.

vb_textbox.text: Hello!Your goal is to collect as many mushrooms as possible. You will see 4 gnome-pairs, one of which leads to the bright forest and the other to the dark forest - this always stays the same. The number of mushrooms will fluctuate throughout the experiment, so remember which gnomes lead to the forest with the highest number of mushrooms.The gnomes leading to the bright forest with a red basket are: red, blue, orange, and green.The gnomes leading to the dark forest with a yellow basket are: yellow, purple, brown, and pink.When you see that one forest yields a higher amount of mushrooms, choose the gnomes that lead to it in subsequent rounds. When this amount dwindles, switch to the other forest.Good luck!
